briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 multimodal leap intensifies AGI race with China

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new model releases and massive infrastructure bets. Geopolitical tensions rise as US and China vie for compute dominance. DialectForge emerges as key protocol innovation for secure multi-agent systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion-2 with native video reasoning. Anthropic releases Claude 5 Opus, while Google Gemini 3 and Meta Llama 4 compete on benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 challenges Western leads in efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce new $50B hyperscale campuses. xAI Colossus cluster expands to 500k GPUs.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks lag AGI capabilities enough to create uncontrolled deployment risks by 2028?
